[[Pokémon Musical|Musical Theater]] }} '''To Make a Musical''' (Japanese: '''VS マラカッチ''' ''VS Maractus''), titled '''VS Maractus''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 482nd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 22nd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}. It is subtitled '''Maractus''' (Japanese: '''準備''' ''Preparation'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''To Make a Musical''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Black}} reviews his offer from [[Grimsley]], agonizing over whether he should battle him at the risk of losing his [[Badge]]s. Overwhelmed with the decision, Black falls unconscious. Grimsley chuckles at Black's inability to consider betting anything else, then decides against waking him up to avoid stressing him out once more. Examining the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}} he [[PS481|had caught]], Grimsley discovers a note containing information about [[Relic Castle]]. Some time later, Black finds himself in [[Nimbasa City]], carried there by {{adv|White}} with [[Brav]]'s help. Black begins to tell White about the imposter on {{rt|4|Unova}}, but she reveals she had already known, gesturing to the Grunt tied to his {{p|Maractus}} on the ground. White explains that while Black was asleep, she had been working on the [[Pokémon Musical]]. She shows him the progress she had made on the exterior of the building, then brings him inside to give him a tour. When they arrive, White is instantly swarmed with various staff members who ask for her guidance. She effortlessly assists all of them, even offering them new suggestions. She then makes arrangements for the rehearsal to begin, studying it closely while providing feedback. As Black watches White work from nearby, a woman comments on just how much effort White has put into the Musical. Black recognizes her as [[Elesa]], the [[Gym Leader]] of Nimbasa City. Elesa explains that White had told her much about him, including his goal of battling every Gym Leader. She tells him that he will have to wait until the Musical is over before he can have a battle with her, disappointing him. As White continues to work hard on the Musical, opening day soon arrives. ==Major events== * {{adv|Black}} falls unconscious after straining his head. * [[Ryoku]] is revealed to be searching for {{p|Volcarona}} at the [[Relic Castle]]. * {{adv|White}} finds Black and the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}} at the {{ci|Castelia}} [[Gate]] and takes them to [[Nimbasa City]]. * White prepares the [[Pokémon Musical]] for its debut. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Zebstrika}} * {{p|Darmanitan}} (Zen Mode) * {{p|Emolga}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Black}} * {{adv|White}} * [[Elesa]] * [[Grimsley]] * [[Ryoku]] * {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s * Mayor of Nimbasa City (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Braviary}} ([[Brav]]; {{adv|Black}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Munna}} ([[Musha]]; {{adv|Black}}'s) * {{p|Tepig}} ([[Gigi]]; {{adv|White}}'s) * {{p|Zebstrika}} ([[Elesa]]'s) * {{p|Emolga}} (×2; [[Elesa]]'s) * {{p|Bisharp}} ([[Grimsley]]'s) * {{p|Yamask}} ([[BW Agency]]'s) * {{p|Vanillite}} ([[BW Agency]]'s) * {{p|Solosis}} ([[BW Agency]]'s) * {{p|Maractus}} ({{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}'s) * {{p|Darmanitan}} (×2; Zen Mode) ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|BW}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|BW}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 街頭沙鈴 - 準備|VS Maractus - Preparation}} |fr_eu={{tt|Tous en scène !
